Only one of the review papers in your set covers DRX cathodes in any depth: **Muralidharan et al., "Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Cathodes," *Adv. Energy Mater.* 2022** (aenm-2022). Its DRX section (Section 5, pp. 9–10, with Figures 8 and 9 on pp. 10–11) cites **12 distinct references: [27], [34]–[44]**.

- **Main text (pp. 9–10):** [27], [34], [35], [36], [40], [41], [42], [43], [44], which is 9 references.
- **Figure captions only (p. 10 for Figure 8, p. 11 for Figure 9):** [37], [38], [39], which adds 3 more.

If you count only the main-text citations, the number is 9.

The other reviews don't really cover DRX. The surface-coatings review (ensm-2021) mentions "disordered rock salt type" only in a list, without citations. The recycling review (mattod-2020), the roll-to-roll perspective (ensm-2020), and the cobalt-free NFA research article (adma-2020) do not discuss DRX cathodes.
